tool_summary: Securely deletes a file by overwriting its contents to make recovery difficult or impossible, optionally removing it afterward.
platform_notes: shred is a GNU coreutils tool, standard on Linux. Not present on macOS/BSD by default. This ruleset targets Linux only.

rules.description: Any invocation overwrites the target file's contents, making the original data unrecoverable by design. This is the tool's entire purpose and cannot be performed non-destructively.
